import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import re

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")


# Basic text preprocessing
def preprocess_text(text):
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text


train_df["text"] = train_df["text"].apply(preprocess_text)
test_df["text"] = test_df["text"].apply(preprocess_text)

# Extract features with TF-IDF using character n-grams
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(3, 5), max_features=5000, min_df=2, sublinear_tf=True
)
X_train = tfidf.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
X_test = tfidf.transform(test_df["text"])

# Labels
y_train = train_df["author"]

# Stratified train/validation split for validation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, stratify=y_train, random_state=42
)

# Train LightGBM classifier
lgbm = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=31,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
lgbm.fit(
    X_tr,
    y_tr,
    eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
    eval_metric="multi_logloss",
    callbacks=[lightgbm.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Predict on validation set and compute log loss
val_proba = lgbm.predict_proba(X_val)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_proba)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_proba = lgbm.predict_proba(X_test)

# Create submission file
submission_df = sample_submission.copy()
submission_df["EAP"] = test_proba[:, 0]
submission_df["HPL"] = test_proba[:, 1]
submission_df["MWS"] = test_proba[:, 2]

# Ensure probabilities are within safe bounds for log loss
eps = 1e-15
submission_df[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]] = np.clip(
    submission_df[["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]], eps, 1 - eps
)

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
